Welcome to

ALTÆR

A modern church with a rural feel.

A place to meet God.
A place to sacrifice.
A place to change.

Why we began

Grown from what we learned.

Altær grew out of hard seasons in other churches. Many of us have sat in congregations where decisions were made behind closed doors and explained poorly, and we watched relationships strain under it.

Those seasons taught us something. The way leaders decide and communicate shapes every relationship in a church. When it is done in the open, trust grows, people speak honestly, and they draw closer to one another and to God.

We began Altær to practice what we learned. We are still learning, and when we get something wrong we will say so plainly and grow from it. The four tenets below are what those lessons became.

Four tenets

A new church, built on four things.

Altær is a modern church with an old shape. These four tenets decide how we lead, how we worship, and how we spend our time.

  1. i

    Relationships come first: God, then each other.

    Everything we do is meant to deepen two relationships. Our relationship with God comes first, and our relationship with one another follows from it. If something serves neither, we leave it out.

  2. ii

    We pursue a shared vision, in the open.

    A vision is shared when everyone can see it. Our pastors and elders set the direction of the church and tell the congregation plainly where we are going and why. Decisions and finances are shared openly, and nothing that shapes the life of the church is kept behind closed doors.

  3. iii

    Pastors and elders decide together.

    No single voice stands at the center of Altær. Several pastors serve in different roles, and each shares responsibility for how our ministries are run. They make decisions together with a board of five elders and keep the congregation informed.

  4. iv

    Worship is honest and peaceful.

    We come as we are and we do not perform. Our worship is unhurried, low-tech, and quiet enough to pray in, with room for stillness alongside song.

How we gather

Low-tech, on purpose.

We keep technology to a minimum when we meet. Fewer screens and less production leave more room for God and for the people beside us.

Worship and services

Simple by design

Our worship and our services lean on voices, Scripture, and prayer more than on screens, lighting, or a production. We would sooner hear the room sing than fill it with sound.

Children’s ministry

A place for children, with screens set aside

Altær will have a children’s ministry, and it will be the most low-tech part of what we do. Children will learn through Bible stories, conversation, play, and making things with their hands, alongside adults who know them by name.

How we are led

Leadership is shared here.

Altær has a lead pastor, several pastors with different roles, and a board of five elders. All of them decide together, so the church never depends on one voice or one personality.

Lead pastor

Michael Entrekin

Pastors

Different roles, one shared charge

Our pastors serve in different roles alongside the lead pastor. Each one carries responsibility for how the ministries of the church are run, and none decides alone.

Five elders

A board that shares the decisions

A board of five elders sits with the pastors. Decisions are made by all of them together.

Congregation

A people kept in the open

The congregation is told what is being decided and why. Questions are welcome, and answers are given plainly.

And they continued stedfastly in the apostles’ doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers. Acts 2:42 · KJV
